text_block_list.text:
It's the annual summer camp, and Fuji
Kiseki's
younger schoolmates swoon as
she leads
everyone in proper dorm
leader fashion.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
She's as reliable as ever, and there's no
doubt
she'll become even more valiant
in their eyes by
the end of summer
camp!
text_block_list.name: Монолог
